bibl.title: Reconstructing a Single Roll of Φιλιππικοὶ Λόγοι (P.Oxy. LXII 4314 + P.Oxy. LXX 4764, P.Oxy. XLIX 3435 and PSI XI 1205 + PSI inv. 2018.
bibl.seg: Chiara Monaco, Reconstructing a Single Roll of Φιλιππικοὶ Λόγοι (P.Oxy. LXII 4314 + P.Oxy. LXX 4764, P.Oxy. XLIX 3435 and PSI XI 1205 + PSI inv. 2018.
bibl.note: Reconstructs a single roll of Φιλιππικοὶ λόγοι transmitting the three Olynthiacs and the First Philippic. Claims that the three Demosthenic papyri, two of which belong to the Oxyrhynchus collection (P. Oxy. LXII, 4314 + LXX, 4764 [= MP3 255.01; LDAB 620] and XLIX, 3435 [= MP3 256.1; LDAB 665]) and one to the Società Papirologica Italiana (P.S.I. XI, 1205 [= MP3 259; LDAB 642] + Inv. 2018), have been written by the same scribe and belong to the same roll. - Appendix. P. Oxy. LXX, 4764 + LXII, 4314 (Phil. I, 7-9). New transcription.
